spec.studio_prompt: A minimalist modern round coffee table measuring 100 cm in diameter and 40 cm in height. The table features a thick circular tabletop constructed from light natural oak wood in pale sand-beige tones (#cabaab, #d0c3b8) with an ultra-smooth matte finish highlighting fine linear wood grain and subtle texture variations. The circular top has an elegantly softened underside bevel, resting atop a low-profile matching solid oak pedestal base (#d6ceca). Clean architectural proportions with pure Scandinavian minimalism and flawless joinery.
